Initial release: November 12-21, 2013

== Heroic Otto's Irresistible Box ==

A jam-packed bundle that contains the following:
* 1 [[Stone of Experience|Stone of Heroic Experience]] (2 million [[XP]])
* 5 {{item|Superior Experience Elixir}}s
* 5 {{item|Major Slayer Count Boost}}s
* 6 {{item|Greater Treasure Hunter's Elixir}}s
* 5 {{item|Siberys Spirit Cake}}s
* 3 {{item|Greater Siberys Spirit Cake}}s
* 1 {{item|Complete Reincarnation Timer Reset}}
* Your choice of either a [[Cyan Gelatinous Cube-let|Cyan Gelatinous Cube]] [[Creature Companion]] or 65 [[Astral Shard]]s.

Stone of Experience Information:
* Grants two million XP to the user
** (Enough for most characters to reach level 20.)
** (Enough to take 3rd life+ characters from level 1 to 14 or from level 14 to 20.)
* Can be used at any time during the [[heroic]] level range (Levels 1 to 19).
* The XP grant is increased by these effects:
** {{item|Experience Elixir}}s - up to 50% = one million XP
** Basic Guild bonus - 5%
** [[Heroic Inspiration]] - 5%
** Basic VIP bonus - 10%
*** Additional event based XP bonuses are not counted, VIP bonus XP weekends are

IMPORTANT:
* XP granted caps at heroic level cap (the start of Level 20)
* Maximum Level for Usage: 19
* Only one Stone of Heroic XP can be used per life. (All types of reincarnation reset this except for [[Lesser Reincarnation]].)

NOTE: Otto's box and the [[Stone of Experience|Stone of Heroic Experience]] inside are tradable. The other items inside are not.
